sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Morning debrief with night shift regarding the early-morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street (HQ). Welfare check, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square, all clear:
Welfare check at Durham Street east and west alleyways and businesses within both vicinities, all clear.
Welfare check at Vulcan Lane and businesses within the vicinity, all clear.
Welfare check at Imperial Lane, building sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant in-store they want removed; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the individual had already left. Returning to routes.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint.
A member of the public notified us of an unconscious individual in front of Unichem Pharmacy, requesting assistance.
Arrived at the scene; ambulance already present and dealing with the situation. Standing by to show presence.
Leaving standby and heading to Headquarters so guards can use the restroom.
Restroom break completed; heading back out to routes.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, full sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, all clear.
Standing by under shelter due to rain.
Response call from St Pierre's Sushi, Mid City Arcade, regarding a male individual who stole sushi; assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call; the staff member pointed us in the direction the individual was last seen heading. (Photo on file.)
Finished sweeping Elliott Street through to Darby Street with no sign of the individual; advised staff we will keep a lookout while on patrol.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Echo Route.
Welfare check at Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Recycle Boutique, Pizza Club, Lumi Cafe, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
While on route, noticed a scooter left on the footpath with the keys still attached; standing by until the owner reclaims it while remaining vigilant for response calls.
Leaving standby to commence routes again; the owner has not returned to claim the scooter.
Welfare check and walkthrough of the old AA stairway, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street, all clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club, Roma Blooms, Accord Barbershop, Subway, all clear.
Welfare check at Izmir Kebab and Grill, Little Tiger Dumpling, Kiwi Souvenirs, Amelia Cafe, Printshop, all clear.
Welfare check at People's Barista, Little Albert's Coffee, Barclay's Suites, Bespoke Coffee, all clear.
Returning to check on the scooter at the top of Victoria Street West; a member of the public in front of City Liquor reported it has been there a while and is worried someone might take it.
Arrived back at the scooter location; still here. Calling Auckland Council to handle it.
Auckland Council will send a team; standing by until they arrive.
Police and Auckland Council arrived and suggested we take the scooter to the Federal Street police station.
Called Hasi and AJ to update them on the police suggestion.
While on route to take the scooter to the office, received a call from Auckland Council Wardens advising that footage showed the individual who left the scooter going into the salon next door.
Called the salon; staff answered and confirmed it is one of their customer's scooter.
Helped staff carry the scooter into their workplace and reminded the owner not to leave it unattended due to the high risk of theft.
Called Hasi to update him and were asked to bring up timesheets.
Finished taking timesheets up; debrief with management regarding timesheets and clock-in/clock-out times.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear. Ending Echo Route and commencing Delta Route.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check at The Hub, Infosys, Westpac, Souvenirs, T2 Tea, Montblanc, Oakley, PB Tech, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Evan's Kebab, Vape Haven, Right Track Sports Bar, Murdochs, Seoul Night, KFC, Vapor King, Jo & Joe, all clear.
Welfare check at Hoka, UGG Shoes, North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check through Canterbury Arcade and businesses within the vicinity, all clear.
Response call from Kebab and Curries on Vulcan Lane regarding a male individual causing a disruption inside the store; assistance requested.

Arrived at the response call; staff said he had already left, but the description matched a street individual known as 'Little Ricky'. Will keep aware and have a word with him if seen to encourage compliance.
Survey sheets handed in; heading into lunch break.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

Debrief with morning shift regarding the status of the CBD.
Suiting and gearing up for deployment.
Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to the public.
Leaving standby and patrolling towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare check on stores along the way towards Britomart Square.
Standing by between Durham Street east and west alleyways to show presence.
Commencing patrols again; due to busy foot traffic and most response calls coming from the main strip of Queen Street, we will prioritise longer standbys on the main street.
Standing by to show presence at the corner of Wyndham and Queen Street.
Walking and welfare check on stores within Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Kathmandu, Macpac, Art Gallery, Faraday, Partridge Jewellery, Queens Jewellery, Sail Away Souvenirs, Michael Hill, all clear.
Welfare check at Taco Bell, Shortland Mini Mart, all clear.

Welfare check at Cartier, Quest, Luxury Karaoke, Western Union Money Exchange, Fable, Cookes, Q Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Imperial Lane, building sweep around the area.
Welfare check and sweep completed; heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone (sitting at 1%).
Arrived at the top corner of Victoria Street and Albert Street intersection; sweeping down to the bottom of Britomart in case we run into the thief.
Swept the intersection between Wyndham and Albert Street; no sign of the thief.
Met up with Commercial Bay security at the corner of Mills Lane and Albert Street, conducting a sweep together.
No sign of the individual; returning to routes on Queen Street.
Welfare check at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area. Standing by to show presence due to a recent incident involving Coach bags stolen.
Still standing by to show presence.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Movenpick Hotel, Daily Bread, Deli & Bakery, 4 Square, all clear.
Welfare check at Dilworth Building entrance Customs Street, Custom Mart, Burger Fuel, all clear.
Walkthrough of Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Snickel Lane and stores within the lane, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters to conduct the mandatory building sweep.
Arrived back at Headquarters; guards take off vests before commencing floor checks.
Commencing Alpha Route again; mandatory building check completed.
Welfare check at Footlocker, Cosmetic Clinic, Unichem Pharmacy, Timezone, ChaPanda, Chating.
Standing by to show presence to the public while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check on all stores within Strand Arcade, all clear:
Walkthrough of Elliott Street towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check inside Mid City Arcade and all businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check at the old Smith and Caugheys building, now known as Titanic The Human Story, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to the public.
Still standing by to show presence before moving to the last check-in for Alpha Route.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square.
Welfare check at Civic Souvlaki, Starks, Daiso Japan Mart Convenience Store, Burger Fuel, Gameon, Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, all clear.
Standing by to show presence; kids and families playing in the square at the young play set-up.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route.
Check-in at Aotea Square, all clear.
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Welfare check at Munster Inn, Nandos, Robo Cafe, Met Tea, Burger Time, Queens Food Court, Airedale Suites Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers, all clear.
Welfare check at Sumthin Dumpling, Chongcha, Thai Food, Lorne Street fountain. Standing by to show presence to customers heading into Lorne Street restaurants.
Still standing by to show presence.
Heading to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone (sitting at 9%).
Arrived back at Headquarters; standing by to charge the Ops Phone while remaining vigilant for response calls.
Ops Phone at 80%, near full for handover to Night Shift. Heading into lunch break.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrol on Beta Route towards Aotea Square. Conducted a refresher briefing with Rico on the new time-keeping process.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Aotea Square all good; took shelter as it started raining. Commencing patrols towards Sky Tower.
Aotea train station all clear, no issues to report.
77 Convenience Store Federal Street all clear. Sky Tower and surrounds all clear, no issues to report.
Federal Street all clear, no issues to report.
Ace Karaoke welfare check all clear. Standing by as a group of intoxicated individuals just left the bar.
Cathedral Church and surrounding area all clear, no issues to report.
Wyndham Street all clear, no issues to report.
Commencing Alpha Route to Britomart via Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear. Standing by for calls.
Britomart McDonald's — quite a few vagrants around; maintained security presence. (Photo on file.)
Welfare check on AHS all clear. Alim, our ASG guard, was on post. No issues to report.
Fort Lane all clear, no issues to report.

Welfare check on Metropolis all clear. One noise complaint was handled professionally by our guard Conor, and a smoke alarm that went off in one of the rooms was brought under control by the ASG guard.
Standing by for some time at Metropolis.
Welfare check on Metropolis all clear; the earlier noise complaint and smoke alarm both handled professionally by our guard Conor.
Welfare check on Radisson RED all clear, no issues to report. ASG guard Lincoln was on post. Standing by for calls.

High Street all clear. While on patrol, a Police vehicle pulled up and officers advised they were looking for a large male wearing black shorts and a grey hoodie; we will keep an eye out around the area.
Lorne Street and Auckland Library sweep all clear, no issues to report. Heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report. Took shelter for a period as it started raining.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Heading to Headquarters for break; standing by for calls.
At Headquarters having break; standing by for calls.
Standing by at Headquarters to hand over to the morning shift team.
Night shift handover completed and given to morning shift.
